=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:897-917 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `lookup` searches or lists only the three newest-updated `ai:permission-prompt` issues and can return `found: false` when the requested session report exists outside that window.
  WHY: The operator's poller can fail to retrieve the command and issue link for a blocked session; all reviewers rated this Major.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:9, .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:9 | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Interpolating a session title inside the double-quoted `session-meta --title` shell argument allows `$()` or backtick characters in the title to be expanded by the shell.
  WHY: A title such as `$(touch /tmp/exploit)` can execute a command before `session-meta` runs.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py: _record_by_digest (lines 740-754), _last_record (lines 723-737) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_record_by_digest` and `_last_record` read the whole log, and `_record_by_digest` hashes every line, making each `report-now` call O(N) in the log size.
  WHY: A long-running session with thousands of logged prompts or denials incurs work proportional to the entire log for each call.
- .claude/hooks/permission_prompt_logger.py:136-137 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The hook spawns a detached Python process for every `PermissionRequest`, including attended sessions where the child exits after finding the session is not unattended.
  WHY: Each such request incurs a fork, exec, and log-file read for a report that is skipped.
- README.md:1076-1089; CLAUDE.md:1373+; agents.md:1139-1158 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: README.md and CLAUDE.md document `permission_prompts.py lookup --session <id>` without noting that `--repo` must be supplied when the current directory has no Git remote identifying the repository.
  WHY: Running the documented command in that environment exits with an error JSON instead of the documented `found` JSON.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py: _report_to_filing_repo (lines 757-769), _report_now at line 843 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Every `report-now` call targeting `FILING_REPO` performs a fresh paginated issue-list read, including when a prior report has already filed the signature.
  WHY: Up to five distinct signatures can cause up to five reads of the same labelled-issue list for a session.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: #4755 G4 — "The operator's poller can get the sanitized command and the issue link for a stuck session in at most two REST reads through a new read-only `permission_prompts.py lookup --session <id>`."
  expected_change_site: `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` `lookup` / `_lookup_candidates`
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `lookup` issues up to 1 search read + up to `LOOKUP_MAX_HITS` (3) comment reads = up to 4 REST reads, exceeding the "at most two" budget; the window defect also produces false `found: false`. This is a deviation from G4, but it is explicitly tracked by follow-up issue #5126 (plan committed in this PR at `docs/plans/issue-5126-lookup-full-label-scan-plan.md`), so the gap is acknowledged rather than silently dropped. Citing per the "deferred requirements are not gaps" rule, this is recorded for reviewer awareness, not as a blocker against #4755's delivery.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: `lookup` can return `found: false` even though the report exists, leaving the operator without the command or issue link for a blocked unattended session.

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:9, .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:9 | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: Interpolating a session title inside the double-quoted `session-meta --title` shell argument allows `$()` or backtick characters in the title to be expanded by the shell.

  PROBLEM: Both helpers read the whole log, and `_record_by_digest` hashes every line, making each `report-now` call O(N) in the log size.
  WHY: A long-running session with thousands of logged prompts or denials incurs work proportional to the entire log for each call.

  PROBLEM: `_lookup_candidates` slices the paginated labelled-issue list to three results, so `lookup` can miss an existing report outside that window.
  WHY: When more than three newer labelled issues push the report beyond the cap, `lookup` returns `{"found": false}`; the test `test_lookup_fallback_checks_comments_and_caps_the_hits` pins the behavior.
- README.md lines 1076-1089, CLAUDE.md §23.I block (line 1373+), agents.md (line 1139-1158) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: README.md and CLAUDE.md omit that the lookup command requires `--repo` when the current directory has no Git remote identifying the repository.
  WHY: In that environment the documented command exits with an error JSON instead of the documented `found` JSON.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py: _report_to_filing_repo (lines 757-769), called from _report_now at line 843 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Every `report-now` call targeting `FILING_REPO` performs a fresh paginated issue-list read, including when a prior report has already filed the signature.

  WHY: The operator's master poller gets no command or issue link for a stuck session, defeating G4 of issue #4755; sessions with more than three reports can also be cut off.
